anchor: OWHS v0.1 provisional; seeded from the steward's safeguarding taxonomy (categories only, no data)
notes: PROVISIONAL AND GOVERNANCE-OWNED. Records tagged with any of these categories are excluded from employer-visible outputs at ANY group size (privacy profile P4). Owner: the steward (founder) until a co-steward governance body exists; ratifying this list is designated as one of the FIRST formal acts of that body. Drawing this line wrong either leaks sensitive signal or suppresses legitimate risk data, so it is a policy decision, never an implementer one.
